theater: 黎凡特海岸與三角洲東岸

battle.name: 西克索人的入侵
battle.theater: 黎凡特海岸與三角洲東岸
battle.brief: 前1650年前後，西克索人自敘利亞與巴勒斯坦沿黎凡特海岸進入埃及，佔領三角洲東岸沼澤中的阿瓦利斯，再逐步接管三角洲諸邦，建立第十五王朝。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝（約前3200年）工藝，與本役相隔約一千五百年，不在戰場上；當時真正改變戰局的是西克索人帶入的複合弓與輕型戰車。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方，是一個正在解體的埃及王權，與一支以西亞戰車民族為主幹的外來聯盟。開戰前的埃及並非統一國家：第十二王朝崩解之後，第十三王朝的君主只能以「兩國的控制者」自居，實控範圍縮到三角洲南端與中埃及；尼羅河三角洲的西部沼澤另有第十四王朝自立，其君主已用完全埃及化的王名與王號，兵源卻大量來自外來族群；上埃及的底比斯則有第十七王朝另立正統，靠阿蒙神廟的祭祀收入與軍人階層維持統治。三個政權互相分割，沒有任何一方能單獨應付三角洲東北方的壓力。進攻方是西克索人聯盟：核心是自敘利亞、巴勒斯坦與黎凡特海岸遷入的西亞族群，以阿瓦利斯為都城，在埃及文獻中被稱為「尼赫西」（亞洲人），其君主所用的「赫卡哈蘇特」意為「外邦的統治者」，正是後來「西克索」一名的由來。聯盟的力量核心是一批裝備輕型戰車與複合反曲弓的戰車民族，輔以被納入體系的三角洲地方王族與徵召兵，構成第十五王朝的統治骨架。入侵之所以得手，關鍵不只在埃及一方的虛弱本身，更在西克索人選中了三角洲東岸沼澤中的阿瓦利斯：那裡是陸路難行的泥淖，卻是唯一能讓車隊、馬匹與船隊同時落腳的渡口，一旦占住，便可分頭控住海路與陸路，再往西的尼羅河谷推展。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were an Egyptian kingship that was coming apart, and a foreign coalition whose backbone was a western Asian chariot people. On the eve of it Egypt was no longer a unified state: after the collapse of the Twelfth Dynasty the kings of the Thirteenth could claim no more than the title of controller of the Two Lands, and in practice held the southern edge of the Delta and Middle Egypt; the western marshes of the Delta had a dynasty of their own in the Fourteenth, whose kings bore thoroughly Egyptianised names and titles while drawing much of their manpower from foreign groups; and in Upper Egypt the Seventeenth Dynasty had set up a separate legitimate line at Thebes, sustaining itself on the revenues of the temple of Amun and on the military class. The three regimes cut one another into pieces, and none was strong enough to face the pressure coming from the north-east of the Delta by itself. The attacking side was the Hyksos coalition: at its core were western Asian lineages that had moved in from Syria, Palestine and the Levantine coast, with Avaris as their capital, called Nehesy, that is Asiatics, in Egyptian texts, while their ruler bore the title hekau khasut, ruler of foreign lands, from which the name Hyksos itself derives. The military strength of that coalition rested on a body of chariot folk armed with light chariots and composite recurve bows, reinforced by the Delta's local dynasts and by recruited levies, and this was the skeleton of the Fifteenth Dynasty. What made the invasion succeed lay not only in the weakness of the Egyptian side but in the place the Hyksos chose: Avaris, in the marshes of the eastern Delta, was a bog country for an army on foot and yet the one landing-place where wagons, horses and ships could all stand at once, and once it was held it commanded the sea road and the land road alike, from which the push up the Nile valley could begin.
people: 推動這場入侵並決定其樣貌的，是三類人。第一類是西克索人的首領與車兵階層：他們之中的「赫卡哈蘇特」以埃及王號自居，把外來征服轉成王朝形式，在阿瓦利斯設宮、設祭壇，使自己看起來是埃及的合法君主；第二類是三角洲原有的地方王族，其中第十四王朝「阿瓦利斯之王」一系，如克赫提、梅里卡雷，本已是受西亞影響很深的王朝，入侵反而讓他們在混亂中取得更大的自主權；第三類是底比斯的軍人階層，第十七王朝靠底比斯駐軍與阿蒙神廟的資源維持軍力，塞克南雷·陶二世在位時已與西克索人通信交涉，其子卡莫斯在位第三年正式沿尼羅河北上開戰，攻破對方在三角洲南部的兵營體系，兵鋒直抵阿瓦利斯城下，卡莫斯留下的石碑殘件記下這一役，也記下截獲阿波比致努比亞求援信使的經過，可見阿波比這位「阿瓦利斯的統治者」正是西克索政權的核心。整場入侵的關鍵人物，最後仍是那位完成北伐的雅赫摩斯一世，他在前十六世紀末建起第十八王朝、攻下阿瓦利斯，把西克索人的勢力逐出埃及；而把戰爭細節留給後世的，是厄爾卡布的軍人雅赫摩斯在墓壁上的自述，他記下自己隨國王戰車馳入陣中，這也是埃及史料裡最早提到馬與戰車的記載。
peopleEn: Three kinds of men drove this invasion and gave it its shape. The first were the Hyksos leaders and their chariot class: the hekau khasut took over the Egyptian royal titulature, turned foreign conquest into a dynasty, and set up a palace and an altar at Avaris so that they would look like legitimate kings of Egypt. The second were the local dynasts of the Delta, among them the line of the kings of Avaris in the Fourteenth Dynasty, such as Khety and Merikare, who were themselves rulers already deeply touched by western Asia; the invasion gave them greater autonomy in the disorder rather than less, and they relied on the Hyksos and were relied on in turn. The third were the military class of Thebes: the Seventeenth Dynasty kept its army alive on the Theban garrison and the resources of the temple of Amun, Sekenenre Tao II had already been in correspondence with the Hyksos, and his son Kamose in the third year of his reign marched north along the Nile and opened the war, breaking the enemy system of barracks in the southern Delta and driving to the walls of Avaris; the fragments of the stela Kamose left behind record that campaign and also the capture of a messenger Apophis had sent to Nubia for help, which shows that Apophis, the ruler of Avaris, was at the heart of the Hyksos regime. The figure who in the end closed the business was Ahmose I, who founded the Eighteenth Dynasty in the late sixteenth century BC, took Avaris and drove the Hyksos out of Egypt; and the man who left the details of the war to posterity was the soldier Ahmose of El Kab, who wrote his own account on the wall of his tomb, recording that he followed the king's chariot into the fighting, the earliest mention of horse and chariot in the Egyptian written record.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期（約公元前3200年）的工藝：木杆前端以銅或青銅矛頭束接，形制簡潔，用途是守住城垣缺口與近身刺擊。它與本役相隔約一千五百五十年，在西克索人進入埃及的戰場上不可能出現；真正決定這場入侵走向的裝備來自西亞。入侵者帶來三樣東西最為關鍵：複合反曲弓，以較短的弓身配較長的弓弦，射程與穿透力都勝過埃及舊有的短弓，使埃及弓兵在開闊的三角洲上難以望其項背；輕型戰車，雙輪、車體窄、以馬匹牽引，車上射手與斧手並列，正是西克索人得以快速推進並衝破埃及步兵縱隊的依據；以及柄部帶止擋的銅斧，屬近東式接柄斧類，是阿瓦利斯出土「斧頭墓」中最具代表性的器物，常被學者視為西克索步兵的制式裝備。埃及一方原有的裝備並不寒酸：早王朝即已成熟的長矛與短弓傳統一路延續，第十六、第十七王朝的步兵仍使用束柄銅矛、木框蒙皮的大盾、投石索與銅箭簇，配以銅斧與短刀，攻城則靠土坡、壕溝與木材等工程手段。兩支部隊真正的差距不在有無某件兵器，而在規格與體系：箭矢能否批量供應，車輪採用何種形制，合金成色如何，戰車怎樣編隊。埃及在這些環節全面落後，入侵者手中為數不多的車兵才成了壓倒性的力量。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to Early Dynastic craftwork of about 3200 BC: a wooden shaft with a copper or bronze head socketed to its front, a plain form meant for holding the gaps in a wall and for stabbing at close quarters. It stands about fifteen hundred and fifty years away from this campaign and could not have been on the field when the Hyksos entered Egypt; the equipment that actually decided the invasion came from western Asia. The invaders brought three things above all. The composite recurve bow, with its shorter stave and longer string, gave range and penetration beyond that of the old short Egyptian bow, so that Egyptian archers could not match them across the open Delta. The light chariot, two-wheeled and narrow-bodied and drawn by horses, carried a shooter and an axe-man side by side, and was the basis on which the Hyksos could advance quickly and break Egyptian columns of foot. And the socketed copper axe with a stop-ridge on the haft, a Near Eastern type, is the most characteristic find in the axe cemetery of Avaris and is often taken as the standard weapon of Hyksos infantry. The Egyptian side was not badly armed: the traditions of the spear and the short bow, mature already in the Early Dynastic period, ran on unbroken, and the infantry of the Sixteenth and Seventeenth Dynasties still carried socketed copper spears, large wood-framed hide-covered shields, slings and copper arrowheads, with copper axes and short knives as well, and took towns with earth ramps, ditches and timber. The real gap between the two armies lay not in the presence or absence of any one weapon but in specification and in system: whether arrows could be supplied in quantity, what form the wheel took, what the alloy was worth, how the chariots were organised in unit. Egypt was behind on every one of these, and that is why the invaders' small body of chariotry became an overwhelming force.
tactics: 這場入侵的戰術可以拆成三段。第一段是滲透與聯絡：西克索人並非以一支大軍一次強攻三角洲，而是分批自黎凡特與敘利亞進入，沿地中海東岸的道路與海路推進，與沿途城邦通商、聯姻、取得棲地，最後集結在阿瓦利斯這個可以同時停泊船隊與安置馬匹的沼澤口岸。控住港口與渡口之後，車兵沿三角洲東岸的平坦道路迅速展開，以複合弓的射程優勢在遠處削弱埃及弓兵，再以車輪與馬匹的衝擊力撞開步兵縱隊；步兵則在車隊掩護下以矛與盾推進，就地結陣固守。第二段是聯絡與分化：阿瓦利斯的西克索政權並未急於滅掉三角洲諸王，而是把承認其宗主地位的本地王族收編為附庸，用歲貢與聯姻換取基地的擴張，同時對底比斯維持半商半貢的關係，兩方書信往來已充滿不平等的語氣。第三段是接管：當第十五王朝在阿瓦利斯坐穩、在孟斐斯取得法老號令與稅收之後，入侵便由軍事行動轉為政治接管，軍隊駐紮關鍵渡口與道路節點，祭司與書吏被納入王朝體系，武器裝備的來源也從戰利品改為本地冶煉與外來原料的交換。
tacticsEn: This invasion can be broken into three stages. The first was infiltration and contact: the Hyksos did not strike the Delta with a single great army, but came in successive groups from the Levant and Syria, advancing along the coastal roads and the sea lanes of the eastern Mediterranean, trading, marrying and taking up quarters in the towns they passed, until they had massed at Avaris, that marshy landing-place where a fleet could lie and horses could be stabled. Once the port and the ferry were held, the chariots could move fast along the flat eastern Delta, use the reach of the composite bow to wear down Egyptian archers from a distance, and then break the infantry columns with the impact of wheel and horse, while the foot followed under the cover of the chariot line, closing with spear and shield and standing firm where they formed. The second stage was subordination and division: the Hyksos regime at Avaris did not hurry to destroy the Delta's kings, but took in those local dynasts who acknowledged its overlordship as dependants, exchanging the extension of the base for tribute and marriage, while keeping half-trade and half-tribute relations with Thebes, the correspondence between the two courts already full of an inequality of tone. The third stage was take-over: once the Fifteenth Dynasty was settled at Avaris and had taken the pharaonic formula and the taxes at Memphis, the invasion turned from a military operation into a political take-over; troops were posted at the ferry-points and at the nodes of the roads, priests and scribes were drawn into the machinery of the dynasty, and the source of weapons shifted from loot to local working and to the exchange of raw material from abroad.
data: 能核對的數字大致如下。年代上，通行編年把第十五與第十六王朝放在前1674至前1548年之間，戰爭列表為本場所記的前1650年正落在其中；西克索人占據阿瓦利斯的時間通常推到前1720年前後，說明入侵是一個橫跨數十年的過程，而非某一年的一次會戰。統治者人數方面，通行編年給第十五王朝六位國王，合計統治約一百零八年，而《都靈王表》第二王表另立「阿瓦利斯的王」一系，所列的人數與年數都遠少於此；這類王室年表只保存了王朝中段的一部分，實情須靠阿瓦里斯的西克索人王陵與「斧頭墓」互相印證。戰役時長方面，阿瓦利斯之圍歷時三年，沙魯亨的戰事再延續三年。地理上，阿瓦利斯即今提爾達巴，位於沙爾基亞省扎加齊格以北約兩公里；底比斯在北緯二十五度七分；第十四王朝「尼赫西」系諸王的領域曾被推到阿比多斯一線，厄爾卡布的德沙沙要塞碑記更顯示外來王名曾出現在上埃及的防線上。兵員與損耗並無可靠數字，現存材料只提到繳獲的戰車、銅器與金銀獎賞。埃及民用曆三百六十五天，十二個月各三十天外加五日閏日，歲首定於汛期初；本卡所標的第4月，只能對應到洪水退去、運糧道路可通的季節，文獻並無確切月日記載。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly these. On dating, the normal chronology puts the Fifteenth and Sixteenth Dynasties between 1674 and 1548 BC, and the year 1650 BC given to this campaign in the list of wars falls inside that span; the Hyksos seizure of Avaris is usually pushed back to about 1720 BC, which shows the invasion was a process spread over several decades and not a single battle in a single year. As for the number of rulers, the normal chronology gives the Fifteenth Dynasty six kings ruling about one hundred and eight years in all, while the Second King List of Turin sets up a separate line of the kings of Avaris whose names and years are far fewer; such royal lists preserve only part of the middle of a dynasty, and the truth has to be recovered by checking the Hyksos royal tombs at Avaris and the axe cemetery against one another. On the length of the fighting, the siege of Avaris lasted three years and the war at Sharuhen three years more. On geography, Avaris is the site of Tell el-Dab'a, about two kilometres north of Zagazig in Sharqia province; Thebes lies at 25.7 degrees north; the line of the Nehesy kings of the Fourteenth Dynasty was pushed as far as Abydos, and the inscription from the fortress of Deshasha at El Kab shows that a foreign royal name could appear on the line of defence of Upper Egypt itself. There is no reliable figure for the numbers of men or for the losses; the surviving material mentions only the chariots, the copper work and the awards of gold and silver that were taken. The Egyptian civil calendar had 365 days, twelve months of thirty days and five epagomenal days, with the year beginning at the start of the inundation; the fourth month marked on this card can therefore correspond only to the season after the flood had fallen and the grain roads were open, and the sources give no exact day or month.
cause: 把起因拆開看，是三層原因疊在一起。底層是埃及自身的結構性耗損：第十二王朝在中王國晚期已無法再集中全國的財力與人力，第十二王朝崩解之後，第十三王朝守住三角洲南端，西部沼澤另有第十四王朝自立，底比斯的第十七王朝另立正統，三方互相牽制，沒有一方能壓倒其餘。最上層的導火索是地理與商路：阿瓦利斯在三角洲東岸的沼澤與鹽鹼地之間，是尼羅河唯一能把海船與陸路車隊接在一起的渡口，控制它等於同時掐住黎凡特的商路與三角洲的耕地；而當時東地中海的商路正在蕭條、饑荒與族群遷移之中重組，一批在西亞學會騎射與駕車的部族沿著這條線進入了埃及。中層是外來集團在埃及內部已有的基礎：所謂「西克索人的入侵」，在現今研究裡多半不視為一次軍事的突襲，而是數十年乃至上百年間，和平遷入、經商、通婚與接管城鎮的過程，最後由一位首領奪取王位、沿用埃及王號，把既有的外來居民網絡變成一個王朝。埃及人後來用「赫卡哈蘇特」來稱呼這批統治者，字面意思是「外邦的統治者」，正是要把它寫成一段合法、但明確屬於外人的歷史。
causeEn: Taken apart, the origins of this war are three causes piled one on another. At the bottom is Egypt's own structural exhaustion: by the late Middle Kingdom the Twelfth Dynasty could no longer concentrate the wealth and the labour of the whole country, and after it collapsed the Thirteenth held the southern edge of the Delta, the western marshes had a dynasty of their own in the Fourteenth, and the Seventeenth set up a separate line at Thebes; the three checked one another, and none could put down the others. At the top is the trigger, and it was geography and trade: Avaris, in the marshes and salt flats on the eastern Delta, was the one place on the Nile where sea ships and land convoys could be joined, and holding it meant controlling both the commercial road of the Levant and the arable land of the Delta, at a time when the trading system of the eastern Mediterranean was being rearranged by depression, famine and the movement of peoples, and a body of western Asian lineages who had learned riding and driving on that road came into Egypt. In the middle is the base the incoming groups already had inside Egypt: what is called the invasion of the Hyksos is generally no longer read as a military assault, but as a process lasting decades or even a century, of peaceful migration, trade, marriage and the taking over of towns, ended by a chief who seized the kingship and took up the Egyptian royal titles, turning an existing network of foreign residents into a dynasty. The Egyptians later called these rulers the hekau khasut, ruler of foreign lands, which was their way of writing down a history that was legitimate but plainly not their own.
impact: 這場入侵對埃及的影響，是把它從古王國的末段推入中王國末期的混亂，又從混亂裡推出新王朝的骨架。制度上，入侵者帶來的第一樣東西不是武器，而是征服的樣板：外來人可以建立王朝，可以採用埃及王號與埃及式的宮殿與祭祀，同時把車兵與弓兵當作常備骨幹；這套做法後來被底比斯的第十七王朝原樣接過，再由第十八王朝推廣到全國，成為新王國數百年的軍事骨架。技術上，複合弓、輕型戰車、馬匹與接柄斧在埃及完成制度化，軍隊編制自此以車兵統率弓兵為原則重排，其後對西奈、迦南與赫梯的遠征都建立在這批新裝備之上；埃及本身並非沒有冶金傳統，差距在規格與供應體系，而入侵者提供的示範，正是如何把一支零散的車隊變成可以持續生產與補充的軍備體系。地理與戰略上，阿瓦利斯的得失說明三角洲東岸與沙崙平原的通道是決定埃及北部歸屬的關鍵，掌握海路與西亞聯繫的一方總能在此處施加壓力。代價也確實存在：戰爭與圍城把底比斯王室的財政推向緊縮，第十八王朝重建卡巴王陵的工程因此格外吃力；而底比斯在驅逐西克索人之後系統性地拆毀其建築與文字，抹去這段歷史，也讓後人只能從零星的王陵與陶器拼湊出一段模糊的往事。
impactEn: The effect of this invasion on Egypt was to push it out of the closing phase of the Old Kingdom into the disorder of the late Middle Kingdom, and out of that disorder into the skeleton of a new dynasty. In institutional terms, the first thing the invaders brought was not a weapon but a model of conquest: foreign men could found a dynasty, could take the Egyptian royal titles and keep an Egyptian palace and Egyptian worship, and could make the chariot corps and the archers the standing backbone of their forces; the Theban Seventeenth Dynasty took that model over as it stood, and the Eighteenth Dynasty spread it across the country, and it became the military skeleton of the New Kingdom for several centuries. In technical terms, the composite bow, the light chariot, the horse and the socketed axe were given an institutional form in Egypt, the army was reorganised on the principle that the chariots commanded the archers, and the later campaigns into Sinai, into Canaan and against the Hittites were all built on that new equipment; Egypt had metallurgical traditions of its own, and the gap lay in specification and in the system of supply, while the demonstration the invaders gave was how to turn a handful of chariots into an armament system that could be produced and replaced. Geographically and strategically, the winning and losing of Avaris showed that the eastern edge of the Delta and the Sharon plain were the corridor that decided who owned northern Egypt; whoever held the sea road and the ties with western Asia could always press at this point. The cost was real as well: the wars and the sieges stretched the finances of the Theban court, which is why the rebuilding of the royal tombs at Karnak in the Eighteenth Dynasty was such a heavy undertaking; and after driving out the Hyksos the Thebans pulled down their buildings and their inscriptions and wiped the episode out, which is why the story can now be pieced together only from a few royal tombs and some potsherds.
result: 結果是埃及北部落入西克索聯盟的統治：第十五王朝以阿瓦利斯為都城建立起來，並把控制延伸到孟斐斯與三角洲中段；第十四王朝的「阿瓦利斯之王」一系被收編或取代，埃及進入第二中間期，底比斯的第十七王朝則在數十年後以雅赫摩斯一世起兵收復北方。這場戰爭沒有在一天之內決定，從西克索人進入三角洲到其在北方的統治鞏固，前後以數十年計；戰爭列表把前1650年標在這段過程的中段，實為里程碑而非戰鬥的確切時日。戰役的直接結果是幾項可指名的變化：三角洲東岸的沼澤渡口落到外來聯盟手中，尼羅河下游的稅收與耕地控制權易手，埃及的軍備體系在這十數年裡換成西亞樣式，而「西克索人」這個帶有敵意的稱號，也從此留在埃及的政治記憶裡。往後看，這場入侵真正的收尾在前十六世紀末：雅赫摩斯一世攻下阿瓦利斯，追至沙魯亨，把西克索人的政治存在從埃及清除，同時把他們的技術與編制整體接收過來，留給第十八王朝。
resultEn: The result was that northern Egypt fell under the rule of the Hyksos coalition: the Fifteenth Dynasty was founded with Avaris as its capital and extended its control to Memphis and the middle of the Delta; the line of the kings of Avaris in the Fourteenth Dynasty was absorbed or displaced, Egypt entered the Second Intermediate Period, and the Seventeenth Dynasty at Thebes began the work of recovering the north some decades later under Ahmose I. This war was not settled in a single day: from the Hyksos entering the Delta to the consolidation of their rule in the north was a matter of decades, and the year 1650 BC entered in the list of wars marks the middle of that process, a milestone rather than the exact date of any battle. The direct results are a number of changes that can be named: the marsh ferry on the eastern Delta passed into the hands of the foreign coalition, the taxes and the arable land of the lower Nile changed hands, Egypt's armament was recast in the western Asian manner over those dozen years or so, and the word Hyksos, loaded with hostility, was left behind in the Egyptian political memory. Looking forward, the real conclusion of the invasion came in the late sixteenth century BC, when Ahmose I took Avaris, pursued the enemy to Sharuhen and removed the political presence of the Hyksos from Egypt while taking over their technique and their organisation entire, to hand them on to the Eighteenth Dynasty.
